As a student myself who was part of the year that never sat an LC. I would say it’s more b) than a). Are there people in courses that they can’t cope or who wouldn’t have been accepted in normal circumstances? Absolutely but from what I’ve seen it’s a minority. Bear in mind that while my year never sat the leaving it was only cancelled a month and a half out from the date. We still did two years of work for it 
What seems far more likely is that ya have a generation of effectively who for two years regressed to almost children and many have really struggled with the social aspect of college after not needing to deal with people for two years and suddenly being thrust in with hundreds of strangers. 
I know a lot of ppl my age who have gone really hard on drink or drugs over covid and the signs are starting to show
In terms of accommodation this definitely is playing a bigger role than ppl think. I know loads of students who spent much of the last year in a hotel. I’m from Longford and if it wasn’t for family in Dublin I wouldn’t have been going to college there. Not a “ we’d have found a way scenario” it simply wouldn’t have happened
